main_text.p: Actor.8. verf.21. cujus cor non est rectum coram DOMINO. In Vocativ. Ὑπακούων ... Luc.15.15.
Ὑπολαμβάνω existimo, Actor.2.v.15. præsumo, Luc.7.43. Fut. ὑπολήψομαι. P. ὑπελαβον, a.2. ὑπελαβον ες s suscepi, Act.1.9. part. a.2. act. ὑπολαβὼν ὁ excipiens seu respon-dens, Luc.10.30.
Ὑπολείπω reliquum facio, relinquo. Fut. ψω. P. ὑπολέλειφα. prǽf.pass. ὑπολέλειμμαι, relinquor. prǽt.pass. ὑπολέλειμμαι. 4.1.pass. ὑπελείφθλω relictus sum.

Ὑπολήνιον ς τὸ (scil. οικος) vas seu labrum quod torculari subjacet, in quod mustum expressum defluit. item lacus in torculari. ex ὑπὸ cum Dat. vel Acc.sub. & λάκκος ὁ lacus torcularii preli, Marc.12.1.
Ὑπολιμπάνω relinquo, idem cum ὑπολείπω. vide supra.

Ὑπομένω sustineo cum Acc. 1.Cor.13.7. (sine casu persevéro, 2.Tim.2.12.) F. ὑπομενῶ suf-feram. P. ὑπεμεινα toleravi. part.prǽt.act. ὑπομείνας ὁ absolutè seu neutraliter sine casu. a.1. ὑπέμεινα remansi, Luc.2.43. item cum Acc. sustinui, Heb.10.32.prǽt.med. ὑπομέμνα, unde est
Ὑπομονὴ ἡς ἡ tolerantia, exspeĉtatio 2.Thess.3. vers.5.
Ὑπομιμνήσκω in memoriam revoco. prǽf.im-perat. ὑπομίμνησκε ἐπὶ suggere. F. ὑπομνήσω memo-

page.notes: Right-margin notes are cut off and largely illegible (fragments such as "memoriam", "suspicor", "confidentia", "subteresugio", "subduco"); not transcribed. Greek forms in the text are approximated where the scan is blurred; the Greek words in the first entries are doubtful.
